title: Diagonal language
statement: For a function $g : \mathbb{N} \to \mathbb{N}$, define a language of finite binary strings by declaring $x$ to belong to it exactly when the diagonal simulation machine does not compute the one-bit output $1$ on input $x$ within $g(|x|)$ steps.
